basis: New Hampshire Fish and Game treats moose as a regionally managed big-game population with explicit White Mountains density objectives/cutoffs; recent published harvest reporting places the White Mountains below its management cutoff.

New Hampshire Fish and Game has independently evaluated camera traps as a method for estimating moose abundance/density, making moose a methodologically appropriate focal species for this camera-monitoring network.
